'''Orsk''' was [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Dauntless (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Dauntless'']]. [[Lira Wessex/Legends|Lira Wessex]] contacted Orsk during her mission to rendezvous with [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Vreen]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]; the Captain was the only person other than her to know of her visit there.
